strategy: Repeatedly cast Spear of the Heavens while maintaining Arbiter of Justice for constant Judgement application. Use Blessed Hammer to detonate Judgements for explosions, lean on Rally and healing for life-based resource spending, and unlock auras for defensive/offensive scaling through level 70.
